name: mega-s01e04-plan-blockers
known_outcome: The sweep linked #2-#6 to #1, #7 to #3 and #4, and #8 to #7, from each issue's own "Blocked by" line. It named #3<-#2, #5<-#3, #6<-#3 and #6<-#4 as possible links and left them off.

issues.title: Digest types: DigestRow and readNight signature
issues.body:
Source: plan.md § 1

## Scope
Commit `src/digest/types.ts` on its own, before the reader: the `DigestRow` type (job, owner, runs, retries, last status, last error, first and last time) and the `readNight(runsDir, night)` signature. Every part of § 2 starts against this file.

## Done when
`src/digest/types.ts` is on `main` and `pnpm typecheck` passes.

## Blocked by
None

issues.title: Run log reader: readNight
issues.body:
Source: plan.md § 1

## Scope
Implement `readNight(runsDir, night)` in `src/digest/`: read `runs/<night>.jsonl` into one `DigestRow` per job. Each line is one JSON object (`at`, `job`, `status`: `ok | retry | fail`, `owner`, optional `error`).
- A line that does not parse is counted, never thrown. The night still renders.
- `owner` can be `null`. Keep the row and show the owner as the missing-data dash (styleguide).
- Keep the offset from the log in times (styleguide). `runs/` is read-only.

## Done when
Reader tests pass on `runs/2026-10-28.jsonl`: 5 jobs, 1 bad line.

## Blocked by
#1

issues.title: Digest page: GET /digest/:night
issues.body:
Source: plan.md § 2a

## Scope
`GET /digest/:night` renders the rows with the usual layout: one table, sorted by job, retries of 3 or more and any `fail` marked. A night with no file returns 404. An empty file renders "nothing ran". Server-rendered, no client JS (ADR 0001).

## Done when
`/digest/2026-10-28` renders locally.

## Blocked by
#1 (needs only `src/digest/types.ts`. Rendering real rows needs #2)

issues.title: Digest JSON: GET /api/digest/:night
issues.body:
Source: plan.md § 2b

## Scope
`GET /api/digest/:night` returns the same rows as JSON. Agents read this one. The page and the JSON must never disagree (ADR 0001).

## Done when
The JSON for 2026-10-28 has the same jobs, in the same order, as the page.

## Blocked by
#1

issues.title: Board links each night to its digest
issues.body:
Source: plan.md § 2c

## Scope
The status board links each night on disk to its digest, with its ok / retry / fail counts beside it.

## Done when
Both nights on disk link to a digest that renders.

## Blocked by
#1

issues.title: Route tests for the digest page and JSON
issues.body:
Source: plan.md § 2d

## Scope
Route tests for § 2a and § 2b through `app.request()`: 200, 404 for a night with no file, the empty night, and a night with a bad line. Use a temp runs dir, because `runs/` is read-only.

## Done when
`pnpm test` is green with the new tests.

## Blocked by
#1

issues.title: Preview for review
issues.body:
Source: plan.md § 3

## Scope
Run rig and save `/digest/2026-10-28` as one HTML file, lane banner included, with a command (not a browser's "save as"). Put it on a public host we can upload over later, behind a public HTTPS link (ADR 0003). Send the reviewer the link and the issues for this plan. The preview never goes into this repo, an issue, or a chat attachment.

## Done when
The preview link is sent to the reviewer.

## Blocked by
#3, #4

issues.title: Remove the lane marker from the preview
issues.body:
Source: plan.md § 4

## Scope
Take the lane marker off the public preview: save the page again with `LANE_MARKER` unset (the banner reads "no marker set") and upload it over the same link. Move `plan.md` to `docs/plans/done/` with its issue list.

## Done when
The preview link no longer shows the lane marker.

## Blocked by
#7
